title: Emergency launch fix
changes: Fixed an infinite Activity Village MutationObserver loop introduced in v11.3.1 that could freeze the app during launch.
Kept Kotoba Colosseum visible while only restoring its launchers when they are actually removed.
Bumped all release-controlled asset URLs and service-worker caches to v11.3.2.
Kept the clickable header version badge update-and-refresh behaviour.
